Chevron's net margin in fiscal Q1 2024 was about 11.2%. This is an estimate from figures I recalled rather than looked up, and I am not fully certain of the revenue number.

- Net income attributable to Chevron was about $5.5 billion (roughly $5,495 million).
- Total revenues and other income were about $48.9 billion.

Net margin is net income divided by total revenues and other income: 5.5 / 48.9 ≈ 11.2%.
